LESSON: WRITING PRACTICE PRACTICE

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.7: Writing Practice PRACTICE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing Practice PRACTICE. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Write letters of the alphabet correctly in class.
2. Take pleasure in using basic tools for writing in class.
3. Enjoy participating in writing practice activities in class. patterns using letters of the alphabet.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Write letters of the alphabet correctly in class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to write letters of the alphabet correctly in class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Take pleasure in using basic tools for writing in class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take pleasure in using basic tools for writing in class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Enjoy participating in writing practice activities in class. patterns using letters of the alphabet.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy participating in writing practice activities in class. patterns using letters of the alphabet. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.
